$comment: Machine-readable inventory of the live playgrounds (docs/playgrounds/*.html, redirect stubs excluded). Hand-maintained; the playgrounds-manifest rule of scripts/verify-docs.ts checks that every live page is listed and every listed page exists, and that the count equals derived.playgrounds in docs/assets/ecosystem.json. Control ids are DOM ids on the page. selfContained: true means every code view of the page (the CODE object shown in #code-view and copied by the Copy button) declares all it uses and imports only from 'pdfnative', so it reproduces the result outside the browser; tests/docs/playgrounds.test.ts runs each such view in Node and locks that promise. false carries a note saying why the page is not covered.
engine: pdfnative@1.9.0 loaded from a CDN (esm.sh, jsdelivr or unpkg); nothing runs server-side

coverageExemptions.name: BidiLevels
coverageExemptions.reason: The return type of resolveBidiLevels; the extreme-scripts rtl preset drives the resolver through layout.direction.

coverageExemptions.name: BidiDirection
coverageExemptions.reason: An alias of TextDirection (the direction parameter of resolveBidiLevels and of layout.direction); the extreme-scripts rtl preset passes 'auto' to both.

coverageExemptions.name: bidiLineLevels
coverageExemptions.reason: The per-line step (L1) of the UAX #9 resolver the engine runs for every wrapped line; the extreme-scripts rtl preset shows the result.

coverageExemptions.name: bidiRunsForLine
coverageExemptions.reason: The reordering step (L2) of the UAX #9 resolver the engine runs for every line; the extreme-scripts rtl preset shows the result.

coverageExemptions.reason: Script detection primitive routed by SCRIPT_SHAPERS; the all-scripts tour renders Gurmukhi through fontEntries.

coverageExemptions.name: isGujaratiCodepoint
coverageExemptions.reason: Per-code-point classifier behind containsGujarati; exercised by the all-scripts tour through font routing.

coverageExemptions.name: isGurmukhiCodepoint
coverageExemptions.reason: Per-code-point classifier behind containsGurmukhi; exercised by the all-scripts tour through font routing.

coverageExemptions.reason: Per-code-point classifier behind containsOdia; exercised by the all-scripts tour through font routing.

coverageExemptions.name: shapeGujaratiText
coverageExemptions.reason: The Indic-engine wrapper SCRIPT_SHAPERS dispatches to; the all-scripts tour shapes Gujarati through buildDocumentPDFBytes.

coverageExemptions.name: shapeGurmukhiText
coverageExemptions.reason: The Indic-engine wrapper SCRIPT_SHAPERS dispatches to; the all-scripts tour shapes Gurmukhi through buildDocumentPDFBytes.

coverageExemptions.name: shapeKannadaText
coverageExemptions.reason: The Indic-engine wrapper SCRIPT_SHAPERS dispatches to; the all-scripts tour shapes Kannada through buildDocumentPDFBytes.

coverageExemptions.reason: The Indic-engine wrapper SCRIPT_SHAPERS dispatches to; the all-scripts tour shapes Malayalam through buildDocumentPDFBytes.

coverageExemptions.name: shapeOdiaText
coverageExemptions.reason: The Indic-engine wrapper SCRIPT_SHAPERS dispatches to; the all-scripts tour shapes Odia through buildDocumentPDFBytes.

coverageExemptions.name: OcspCertId
coverageExemptions.reason: The CertID parseOcspResponse exposes for ocspResponseMatchesCertificate; the ltv-compose-offline recipe reaches both through composeLtvData({ match: 'chain' }) rather than by name, and a page has no OCSP responder to query.

coverageExemptions.name: ecdsaSignHash
coverageExemptions.reason: A raw ECDSA primitive for custom signers (#88); the signing flow a visitor runs is signPdfBytes (recipe signed-pades, pdfnative-cli sign --algorithm ecdsa-sha256).

coverageExemptions.name: ecdsaVerifyHash
coverageExemptions.reason: A raw ECDSA primitive for custom verifiers; PDF signatures are verified by pdfnative-cli verify and the verify_pdf MCP tool, not in a page.

coverageExemptions.name: encodeDerSignature
coverageExemptions.reason: The DER (r, s) encoder behind ecdsaSignHash; a signer primitive with no visible output of its own.

coverageExemptions.name: decodeDerSignature
coverageExemptions.reason: The DER (r, s) decoder behind ecdsaVerifyHash; a verifier primitive with no visible output of its own.

coverageExemptions.name: ocspResponseMatchesCertificate
coverageExemptions.reason: The matcher composeLtvData applies under match: 'chain' to keep the OCSP responses that answer for the signer's chain; the ltv-compose-offline recipe runs that path through composeLtvData rather than by name, and a page has no OCSP responder to query.
